description: The Municipality of Perugia publishes public-lighting data from the PELL 2022 project in its 2023 catalogue entry. The listed Shapefile distribution is an inventory of lighting points and labels its reference year as 2022. Coverage concerns the municipality of Perugia; the metadata does not quantify how many points or neighbourhoods are included. Access is free under Creative Commons Attribution, with no version stated in the native licence label. The lighting-point inventory can supply physical asset locations for public-lighting capacity-planning studies. The archive was not downloaded, so its coordinate system, attribute schema, electrical ratings and network connections remain unknown. A 2023 publication date is separate from the stated 2022 reference year. Related Perugia street and address records concern a different inventory; the source does not establish a shared asset identifier or a direct join between them.
